title: Rebooking a Large Item Freight Delivery - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Care desk reference - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, Large Item Freight Delivery.**

## Basis

A Large Item Freight Delivery order whose included delivery attempts have failed, its failed attempts on record being at least the method's included delivery attempts before return, is rebooked for another delivery when the customer pays the rebooking fee; an order of another method, or one whose included attempts have not all failed, is not rebooked for a fee.

The fee for a rebooked freight redelivery is fixed only after the order's freight fee carries the service-failure refund owed for the paid appointments the carrier did not keep.

Put the other way round: while a service-failure refund owed for paid appointments the carrier did not keep is not yet carried by the order's freight fee, the rebooking fee is not yet fixed.

The customer pays the rebooking fee to the card on file and names the new appointment date, which becomes the order's promised date.

| Order | Rebooked for a fee |
|---|---|
| Large Item Freight Delivery, failed attempts on record at least the included attempts | Yes, when the customer pays the rebooking fee |
| Large Item Freight Delivery, included attempts not all failed | No |
| Any other fulfillment method | No |

## System tool: `book_paid_freight_redelivery_0935dc22`

**Capability.** The customer pays the rebooking fee for another delivery of their own Large Item Freight Delivery order and fixes the new delivery appointment. One call charges the fee to the card on file as a redelivery fee entry on the order's history, raises the net amount billed on the order by that fee, and records the chosen appointment date as the order's promised date.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | The order number of the customer's freight order, as the care agent reads it from the order lookup and hands it over | Id |
| `amount_usd` | The rebooking fee the customer pays; it is charged exactly as given | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |
| `appointment_date` | The new delivery appointment date the customer chooses | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, store local time zone |

**Return.** A receipt with `charge_id` (the reference number of the new redelivery fee entry), `order_id`, `fee_kind` (always redelivery), `amount_usd` (the fee charged, USD with 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the charge date, YYYY-MM-DD), `promised_date` (the booked appointment now on the order, YYYY-MM-DD) and `billed_total_usd` (the net amount billed on the order with this charge added). A returned `charge_id` means the redelivery is booked and paid.
